manifest.name: Bouquet editor
bqe.applied: Channel list applied and saved on the box
bqe.apply_title: Take over the channel list of this bouquet
bqe.changed_on_box: The bouquets were changed on the box.
bqe.discard_title: Discard the channel changes not applied yet
bqe.drop_msg: The channel list has changes not applied yet. They will be lost.
bqe.empty_drop: empty — drag channels here from the right list or add them with +
bqe.gone_msg: No other bouquet holds these channels, which the list leaves out. The box forgets a channel that leaves its last bouquet, and only a channel scan brings it back:
bqe.hint: Reorder channels by dragging or with the arrows, and add them from "All channels" by dragging or with + (double-click adds too). Creating, renaming, moving, hiding, locking and deleting a bouquet is saved on the box at once; a changed channel list with "Apply".
bqe.not_read: Channel list not read - choose the bouquet again
bqe.pick_left: Choose a bouquet in the list of bouquets
bqe.reload_discard: Reload, discarding the changes not applied
bqe.shared: More than one bouquet carries this name - rename one of them on the box first
bqe.hint_rows: Choose a bouquet: its row then shows its buttons, and its channels come up beside it, on a phone under "Channels".
bqe.tip_mode: Edit the TV or the radio bouquets
